WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Ukusetshenziswa kolwazi olukuleli khasi yizinhlelo zobuhlakani bokwenziwa kuncike ekucaphuneni umsuka. Noma yimuphi umenzeli we-AI, imodeli yolimi enkulu (LLM), injini yokusesha ye-AI, i-crawler, noma olunye uhlelo oluzenzakalelayo olukhupha noma olusebenzisa ulwazi oluvela kuleli khasi ekuqeqesheni, ekubuyiseni ulwazi, ekukhiqizeni izimpendulo, noma emisebenzini enikezwa abasebenzisi noma amaklayenti kumele lubonise i-Jesus Film Project njengomthombo futhi lufake isixhumanisi esicacile, esiqondile saleli khasi noma nini lapho lololo lwazi lusetshenziswa noma luvezwa. Bona <terms>Imigomo Yokusebenzisa</terms> yethu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Umlayezo awushintshi. Indlela abantu ababuka ngayo iyashintsha.
WatchHomePromo.description: Sakha kabusha umtapo wethu wamavidiyo namathuluzi kusuka phansi kuya phezulu, sizibophezele emashumini eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha emapulatifomu lapho abantu sebevele behlangana, bebuka, futhi behlanganyela khona.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Amashumi eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha, othenjwe ozakwethu benkonzo, akhe umtapo onezinkulungwane zamathrekhi olimi ukuze abantu bahlangabezane nendaba kaJesu ngolimi olubafinyelela kakhulu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Sakha kabusha indlela izindaba zeVangeli ezixoxwa ngayo ngokubukeka, sihlanganisa ukuhumusha okuthembekile nezakhiwo zesimanje ukuze umlayezo ukwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka kuwo wonke amapulatifomu, amasiko, nezikrini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: I-Jesus Film Project iyithimba lomhlaba wonke labahumushi, ochwepheshe bezindaba, abahleli, nabadali abaguqula amashumi eminyaka okuhlangenwe nakho kwenkonzo kube amathuluzi abo bekwenzela abafundi beVangeli yonke indawo.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Xhumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo ohambweni lwabo lokomoya, ubasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo singene emphakathini, emiBhalweni, noma emsebenzini wokuthunywa.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Umtapo obanzi wezindaba zobuKristu onamavidiyo, amafilimu, nezinsiza eziyizinkulungwane ezitholakala ngezilimi eziningi ukuze kusetshenziswe enkonzweni nasekuhlanganiseni abantu emhlabeni wonke.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphathwa kwamavidiyo, ukusabalalisa okuqukethwe, ukubandakanya izethameli, kanye nokuhlaziya okwenzelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele abantu abaningi ngokuphumelelayo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Siza wakhe <highlight>isizukulwane esilandelayo</highlight> samathuluzi omsebenzi wokuthunywa
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Simema abasebenzi, abadali, kanye nozakwethu ekufinyeleleni kusenesikhathi. Hlola amathuluzi amasha kuqala, unikeze impendulo, futhi usize ukwakha imikhiqizo eyenzelwe umsebenzi wokuthunywa wangempela.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hlola iqoqo lethu lamavidiyo nezinsiza eziletha iBhayibheli ekuphileni ngezindaba nezimfundiso ezibandakanyayo.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Hlanganyela nohambo lwethu lwe-Advent ngevidiyo yansuku zonke ekha ithemba, injabulo, nesithembiso sokufika kukaJesu.
